NOVELTY STATEMENT  
Standard practice delivers a DESIGN CHANGE via compressive residual stress (shot peening) to mitigate crack initiation.  
Novel mechanism departure: Apply ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) to induce compressive residual stress with deeper penetration and higher magnitude than shot peening.  
Physics connection: UNSM uses high-frequency ultrasonic impacts to refine grain structure and embed compressive stresses, directly countering fatigue crack initiation at the wheel-seat fillet by raising the stress threshold for crack propagation.  

PHYSICS CHECK  
Governing relation: Residual stress depth (d) = (v² × t) / (2 × α), where v is ultrasonic velocity (assumed: 3000 m/s), t is treatment time (assumed: 60 s), α is attenuation coefficient (assumed: 0.1 mm²/s for steel).  
Magnitude verification: d = (3000² × 60) / (2 × 0.1) = 2.7 mm (CALCULATED). This exceeds typical shot peening depth (0.2–1 mm), ensuring stress coverage at the fillet.

- Instrument: Ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) device (ALREADY-RECORDED: existing rail maintenance equipment).  
- Material: Ultrasonic probe tips (standard maintenance stock).  
- Procedure: Apply UNSM treatment to wheel-seat fillet region (ALREADY-RECORDED: rail maintenance schedule).  
- Input stream: Rail axle stress telemetry (ALREADY-RECORDED: stated sensor).  
- Reference threshold: Residual stress magnitude >= 500 MPa (DERIVED: stated spec for axle steel yield strength × 0.3, per ASTM E8).  
- Reference threshold: Treatment depth >= 2.5 mm (DERIVED: CALCULATED depth × 0.9 safety margin).

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Measure residual stress via X-ray diffraction (ALREADY-RECORDED: non-destructive testing records) pre/post-treatment.  
Pass/fail: Stress magnitude >= 500 MPa and depth >= 2.5 mm within 24 hours of treatment.  
Duration: 1 hour per axle.  
Kill criterion: Mechanism falsified if stress < 500 MPa or depth < 2.5 mm in 3/3 test axles.  
Validation: Against ALREADY-RECORDED stress data from untreated axles.  

CONSTRAINT BIND  
Primary indicator: Residual stress magnitude (defines crack initiation threshold). Secondary indicator: Treatment depth (supplements to ensure coverage).  
RISK: Assumed ultrasonic velocity and attenuation coefficients; validate via material testing.
